<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
This is my fourth work session, and I still haven't received a reply from Alison. I sent her the list of Elena's and David's availability in my first session. I need to get a response from her to move forward. I'll send her a follow-up message to gently remind her and check if she has had a chance to look at the new times. This is a necessary step to avoid further delays. After sending the message, I will end my session.
